Noesis Capital Mangement Stake in Apple (AAPL) Has Increased by $301,158; As Cemex Sab De Cv (Put) (CX) Stock Value Declined, Shareholder Barclays Plc Lowered Position by $1.38 Million
May 1, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Barclays Plc decreased its stake in Cemex Sab De Cv (Put) (CX) by 75.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Barclays Plc sold 197,448 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.46% with the market. The institutional investor held 65,576 shares of the building materials company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $492,000, down from 263,024 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Barclays Plc who had been investing in Cemex Sab De Cv (Put) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.16B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.94% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $6.03. About 6.17 million shares traded. CEMEX, S.A.B. de C.V. (NYSE:CX) has declined 19.95% since May 1, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 31.50% the S&P500.
Noesis Capital Mangement Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.33% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp bought 1,782 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 19,026 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.22M, up from 17,244 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Noesis Capital Mangement Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $851.98B market cap company. The stock increased 1.60% or $2.65 during the last trading session, reaching $167.91. About 31.59M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Barclays Plc, which manages about $122.49B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Carnival Corp (NYSE:CCL) by 901,663 shares to 962,963 shares, valued at $63.91 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Energen Corp (NYSE:EGN) by 266,132 shares in the quarter, for a total of 357,632 shares, and has risen its stake in Direxion Shs Etf Tr (Call).
